title: macrotyloma daltonii
intro: Macrotyloma daltonii, commonly known as Horse Gram or Madras Gram, is a leguminous plant species native to India and Southeast Asia. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to help manage diabetes, lower cholesterol levels, and provide antioxidant properties that aid in the prevention of various diseases. Macrotyloma daltonii has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
